mystery_box.name: Mystery box
mystery_box.description: Sold in every shop. A random item goes straight into your inventory.

bronze_feather.name: Bronze feather
bronze_feather.description: Your next move is 1.5 times as long (rounded).

silver_feather.name: Silver feather
silver_feather.description: Your next move is 2 times as long.

gold_feather.name: Gold feather
gold_feather.description: Your next move is 2.5 times as long (rounded).

morrigans_throwing_axe.name: Morrigan's throwing axe
morrigans_throwing_axe.description: Halves a rival team's next move. Hostile: the target is then shielded for 12 hours.

quetzal_whistle.name: Quetzal whistle
quetzal_whistle.description: On land only: fly to a random land tile away from the gems.

ogre_boat.name: Ogre boat
ogre_boat.description: At sea only: sail to a random sea tile away from the gems.

group_teleport.name: Group teleport
group_teleport.description: Sends every team that is not moving or in a match to a random shop.

banana.name: Banana
banana.description: Blocker for a tile up to 10 tiles away, for 24 hours. Every team that walks onto it, yours included, stops there, loses the rest of its move and is frozen for 30 minutes.

harpie_bug_swarm.name: Harpie bug swarm
harpie_bug_swarm.description: Blocker for a tile up to 10 tiles away, for 24 hours. Every team that walks onto it, yours included, stops there, loses the rest of its move and is frozen for 1 hour.

snake_charmer.name: Snake charmer
snake_charmer.description: Blocker for a tile up to 10 tiles away, for 24 hours. Every team that walks onto it, yours included, stops there, loses the rest of its move and is frozen for 2 hours.

wilderness_web.name: Wilderness web
wilderness_web.description: Blocker for a tile up to 10 tiles away, for 24 hours. Every team that walks onto it, yours included, stops there, loses the rest of its move and is frozen for 4 hours.

ice_barrage.name: Ice Barrage
ice_barrage.description: Freezes a rival team for 6 hours. Hostile: the target is then shielded for 12 hours.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.description: Freezes a rival team for 3 hours. Hostile: the target is then shielded for 12 hours.

protect_from_magic.name: Protect from Magic
protect_from_magic.description: Passive: blocks the next freeze on your team, then is used up.

leprechaun_hat.name: Leprechaun hat
leprechaun_hat.description: For your next 5 draws, a club pays gold.

saturated_heart.name: Saturated heart
saturated_heart.description: For your next 5 draws, a heart pays gold.
